# Ultimate Modular Characters

Selected FBX character models from Quaternius' **Ultimate Modular Women** and
**Ultimate Modular Men** packs.

- Author: Quaternius
- License: CC0 1.0 (public domain)
- Women source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemodularwomen.html
- Men source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemodularmen.html

Only the five FBX files used by this prototype are included to keep the Unity
project small. Dean and Felix intentionally share the suit mesh but use
different scale, pose and material styling.
